MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT Ranked.AccountId__c AS AccountId__c, Ranked.PostalCode__c AS PostalCode__c, Ranked.Flavor__c AS Flavor__c, Ranked.NicotineLevel__c AS NicotineLevel__c, Ranked.FlavorRank__c AS FlavorRank__c, SUM(Ranked.FRE_EQ_Volume__c) AS FRE_EQ_Volume__c FROM ( SELECT ssot__Account__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS AccountId__c, ssot__Account__dlm.Postal_Code__c AS PostalCode__c, Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c AS Flavor__c, Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.nicotine_level__c AS NicotineLevel__c, SUM(Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.eq_vol__c) AS FRE_EQ_Volume__c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ssot__Account__dlm.Postal_Code__c ORDER BY SUM(Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.eq_vol__c) DESC ) AS FlavorRank__c FROM Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm JOIN ssot__Account__dlm ON Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.KQ_retail_number11__c = ssot__Account__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY ssot__Account__dlm.ssot__Id__c, ssot__Account__dlm.Postal_Code__c, Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c, Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.nicotine_level__c HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.brand_family__c = 'FRE (OST)' THEN Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.eq_vol__c ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.brand_family__c = 'ZYN (OST)' THEN Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.eq_vol__c ELSE 0 END) ) AS Ranked WHERE Ranked.FlavorRank__c <= 10 GROUP BY Ranked.AccountId__c, Ranked.PostalCode__c, Ranked.Flavor__c, Ranked.NicotineLevel__c, Ranked.FlavorRank__c
